CreateCdsDisk.clientToken: Idempotency token, an ASCII string of no more than 64 characters. See [Idempotency](BCC/API Reference/General Instructions.md#idempotency) for details.
CreateCdsDisk.purchaseCount: Number of CDS disks to create in batch. Must be an integer greater than 0, with a maximum of 5 per creation. Optional, defaults to 1.
CreateCdsDisk.name: New disk name (custom image name). Supports uppercase and lowercase letters, digits, Chinese characters, and the special characters -_ /. Must start with a letter, length 1-65.
CreateCdsDisk.description: New disk description. Only supports Chinese characters, letters, digits, period ".", space, underscore "_", hyphen "-", equals sign "=", English comma ",", Chinese comma "，", colon "：", slash "/", and Chinese period "。".
CreateCdsDisk.cdsSizeInGB: CDS disk capacity. Must be an integer greater than 0, in GB, ranging from 5 to 32765 GB. The minimum purchasable capacity for SSD-type cloud disks is 50 GB. Required when snapshotId is empty or does not exist.
CreateCdsDisk.storageType: CDS disk storage type, including enhanced_ssd_pl1 [Enhanced SSD_PL1], enhanced_ssd_pl2 [Enhanced SSD_PL2], cloud_hp1 or premium_ssd [General Purpose SSD], and hp1 or ssd [High Performance Cloud Disk]. Defaults to hp1.
CreateCdsDisk.storageType.hdd: General Purpose HDD (this type is being gradually phased out)
CreateCdsDisk.storageType.sata: Previous-generation cloud disk, dedicated to creating DCC sub-instances
CreateCdsDisk.storageType.local_ssd: Data stored on local SSD disk, with low latency and good IO and throughput performance. Suitable for medium to large relational database workloads.
CreateCdsDisk.storageType.local_hdd 或 std1: Local HDD disk, suitable for large-scale data storage scenarios
CreateCdsDisk.storageType.local_nvme 或 nvme: Local NVMe disk. Data stored on local NVMe SSD disk, with ultra-high performance. Suitable for latency-sensitive workloads.
CreateCdsDisk.chargeType: Billing type (payment method), including Prepaid and Postpaid. This parameter is required only when instanceId is not empty and the corresponding instance type is prepaid. If instanceId is empty, a postpaid CDS is created. If instanceId is not empty: if the instance is prepaid, chargeType must be specified; if the instance is postpaid, a postpaid CDS is created.
CreateCdsDisk.snapshotId: Snapshot ID. Supports creating a disk from a snapshot. When this parameter is present and not empty, the cdsSizeInGB parameter is ignored and is not required.
CreateCdsDisk.shareSnapshotId: Shared snapshot ID. Supports creating a disk from a shared snapshot. When this parameter is present and not empty, the cdsSizeInGB parameter is ignored and is not required.
CreateCdsDisk.zoneName: Specifies the availability zone. Defaults to empty, in which case the system selects automatically.
CreateCdsDisk.autoSnapshotPolicy: The automatic snapshot policy currently configured for the disk
CreateCdsDisk.autoSnapshotPolicy.name: Automatic snapshot policy name. Supports uppercase and lowercase letters, digits, Chinese characters, and the special characters -_ /. Must start with a letter, length 1-65.
CreateCdsDisk.autoSnapshotPolicy.timePoints: Specifies the time points for creating automatic snapshots. The minimum unit is hours, with 24 time points available from 00:00 to 23:00. The parameter is a number from 0 to 23, e.g., 1 represents the 01:00 time point. Multiple time points can be selected. Pass the parameter as a formatted JSON Array: [0, 1, … 23], up to 24 time points separated by commas.
CreateCdsDisk.autoSnapshotPolicy.repeatWeekdays: Specifies the repeat days for automatic snapshots. Select the days from Monday to Sunday on which to create snapshots. The parameter is a number from 0 to 6, e.g., 0 represents Monday. Multiple days can be selected. Pass the parameter as a formatted JSON Array: [0, 1 … 6].
CreateCdsDisk.autoSnapshotPolicy.status: Snapshot policy status: active, deleted, or paused.
CreateCdsDisk.autoSnapshotPolicy.retentionDays: Specifies the retention time for automatic snapshots, in days. -1: retained permanently; 1 to 65536: specified number of retention days.
CreateCdsDisk.autoSnapshotPolicy.createdTime: Creation time of the automatic snapshot policy, in a date format compliant with BCE specifications. (From this field onward, these fields are not returned in the volume API.)
CreateCdsDisk.autoSnapshotPolicy.updatedTime: Most recent update time of the automatic snapshot policy, in a date format compliant with BCE specifications.
CreateCdsDisk.autoSnapshotPolicy.deletedTime: Deletion time of the automatic snapshot policy, in a date format compliant with BCE specifications.
CreateCdsDisk.autoSnapshotPolicy.lastExecuteTime: Last execution time of the automatic snapshot policy, in a date format compliant with BCE specifications.
CreateCdsDisk.renewTimeUnit: Monthly or yearly billing: "month" for monthly, "year" for yearly. **Note: This parameter is deprecated.** When a prepaid CDS is created and attached to a BCC that has auto-renewal enabled, the CDS disk automatically enables auto-renewal with a renewal cycle consistent with the BCC instance.
CreateCdsDisk.renewTime: Auto-renewal duration: 1-9 for monthly, 1-3 for yearly. **Note: This parameter is deprecated.** When a prepaid CDS is created and attached to a BCC that has auto-renewal enabled, the CDS disk automatically enables auto-renewal with a renewal cycle consistent with the BCC instance.
CreateCdsDisk.instanceId: Creates a disk and attaches it to this instance. A prepaid CDS must be attached to a prepaid BCC. **Note:** When a prepaid CDS is created and attached to a BCC that has auto-renewal enabled, the CDS disk automatically enables auto-renewal with a renewal cycle consistent with the BCC instance.
CreateCdsDisk.relationTag: Whether the tags specified for the CDS to be created need to be associated with existing tag keys. Defaults to false. Note: when set to true, ensure the tag key already exists.
CreateCdsDisk.deleteWithInstance: Whether the disk is deleted along with the instance. Takes effect when the billing method is pay-as-you-go (postpaid). Initial value is false. For the V2 API, the cdsAttributeActive parameter must be set to true when releasing the instance for this to take effect.
CreateCdsDisk.billing: Specifies the purchase duration when creating a prepaid disk. By default, aligns with the BCC expiration time. The expiration time of a prepaid disk must be later than or equal to the BCC expiration time.
CreateCdsDisk.billing.paymentTiming: Payment method, including Prepaid, Postpaid, and bidding (spot instance).
CreateCdsDisk.billing.reservation: Reservation information. Not required when the payment method is postpaid; must be set when prepaid.
